name: Johan Jongkind
description: Dutch painter and printmaker regarded as a forerunner of Impressionism (1819-1891)

summary.text: Johan Barthold Jongkind was a Dutch painter and printmaker. He painted marine landscapes in a free manner and is regarded as a forerunner of impressionism.
summary.title: Johan Jongkind

19912657: View from the Quai d'Orsay is a mid-19th century painting by the Dutch artist Johan Barthold Jongkind. Executed in oils on canvas, the painting is currently in the collection of the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
